economy.summary: His campaign platform lists a thriving economy, affordable living, and safe communities as its cornerstones, saying he wants Lebanon County to be a great place to live, work, and raise a family.
economy.short: Platform lists thriving economy and affordable living as cornerstones.

taxes.summary: In announcing his 2026 re-election bid, he cited his advocacy for legislation to save taxpayers money and his co-sponsorship of House Bill 900, which seeks long-term solutions to Pennsylvania's property tax system.
taxes.short: Co-sponsors property tax reform bill; advocates saving taxpayers money.

abortion.summary: During his 2022 campaign he described himself as pro-life and said he supports the rights of the unborn.
abortion.short: Describes himself as pro-life; supports rights of the unborn.

education.summary: His official biography says he focuses on providing a quality education system for Pennsylvania school children. He chairs the House Education Committee's Subcommittee on Career and Technical Education, tasked with making vocational education more available across the commonwealth, and co-sponsored House Bill 27, a law addressing the statewide substitute teacher shortage.
education.short: Focuses on quality schools; chairs vocational education subcommittee.

healthcare.summary: His official biography says he focuses on protecting long-term care and at-home services for senior citizens, and he serves on the Governor's Advisory Committee for Alzheimer's, Dementia and Related Disorders.
healthcare.short: Focuses on protecting senior long-term care and at-home services.

guns.summary: His official biography lists protecting the constitutional rights to free speech and to bear arms among his continuing priorities.
guns.short: Lists protecting the right to bear arms among priorities.
